# docs.paypal.ai documentation — Growth — Grow Business

> 19 page(s) of docs.paypal.ai documentation — Growth under Grow Business. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Grow Business

- [Add a Donate button to your website with PayPal's Donate SDK](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/donate/integration.md): With the Donate SDK, users can select the PayPal Donate button to donate in a pop-up overlaid on your website.
- [Choose between Invoicing solutions](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/choose-solution.md): PayPal Invoicing supports two ways to create and manage invoices:
- [Core concepts](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/core-concepts.md): The PayPal Invoicing API helps you create, send, and track invoices programmatically. This page describes the core resources, the invoice lifecycle, and the authentication model.
- [Errors](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/errors.md): All Invoicing API error responses follow a consistent structure. This guide covers error codes, retry guidance, and client handling patterns.
- [Invoice object](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/invoice-object.md): An invoice is a payment request you send to a customer for goods or services delivered.
- [Invoice lifecycle and status flow](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/lifecycle.md): PayPal Invoicing defines a set of statuses that represent an invoice's lifecycle. Most invoices follow a simple flow: **Draft** → **Due** → **Paid** (or **Cancelled**).
- [Overview](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/overview.md): PayPal Invoicing lets merchants and partners create and send itemized invoices and get paid through a secure PayPal payment page, without building their own payment flow.
- [Quick start using Dashboard](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/quickstart.md): Use this guide to create and send an invoice from the [PayPal Business Dashboard](https://www.paypal.com/mep/dashboard), using only commonly used and required fields—no code…
- [Quick start using Invoicing API](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/quickstart-api.md): PayPal Invoicing API helps you create, update, send, and manage invoices programmatically from your backend systems.
- [Reference](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/reference.md): Use the PayPal Invoicing API to create, send, and manage invoices programmatically. This page covers all endpoints, request parameters, response objects, and error codes.
- [Templates](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/templates.md): Templates let you save reusable invoice details such as your business information, standard line items, payment terms, and display preferences so you don't have to repeat them…
- [Test and go live](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/test-go-live.md): Use test values to simulate error responses with the PayPal Invoicing API and verify that your application handles different scenarios correctly.
- [Troubleshooting Invoicing API](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/troubleshooting.md): The PayPal Invoicing API returns specific error codes and messages to help you troubleshoot integration issues.
- [Use cases](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/use-cases.md): Explore key ways to apply the PayPal Invoicing API in your billing and payment collection flows.
- [Manage your domain](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/use-your-email-domain/manage-domain.md): Manage your verified custom email domain after you complete the initial setup.
- [Overview](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/use-your-email-domain/overview.md): Send PayPal invoice emails from your own email domain instead of [service@paypal.com](mailto:service@paypal.com).
- [Set up your domain](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/use-your-email-domain/set-up-domain.md): Send PayPal invoice emails from your own domain instead of a paypal.com address.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/use-your-email-domain/troubleshooting.md): Resolve verification failures, bounce issues, and DNS configuration errors.
- [Invoicing webhooks](https://docs.paypal.ai/growth/grow-business/invoicing/webhooks.md): When a merchant creates, updates, pays, or cancels an invoice, PayPal sends a webhook event to your server. Your server can then process the events automatically.
